units.title: HEALTH AND SAFETY PRACTICES IN ICT AND DIGITAL WORKSPACES

learning_outcomes.description: Understand ergonomic principles in ICT workspaces

performance_criteria.description: Identify common ergonomic risks in digital workspaces.
Demonstrate proper workstation setup for ergonomic safety.
Apply ergonomic practices to prevent strain and injury.
Evaluate ergonomic improvements in a digital workspace setting.

learning_outcomes.description: Promote cyber safety and digital hygiene

performance_criteria.description: Recognize the importance of secure digital behaviour.
Implement secure practices for handling digital devices and data.
Demonstrate secure password management and data encryption techniques.
Evaluate the risks of using public networks for digital tasks.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify mental health challenges in ICT environments

performance_criteria.description: Discuss common mental health issues associated with prolonged digital work.
Implement strategies to maintain mental well-being during long work hours.
Evaluate the effectiveness of mental health initiatives in ICT workspaces.
Recognize early signs of digital burnout and stress.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply health and safety regulations in digital workspaces

performance_criteria.description: Identify relevant health and safety regulations applicable to ICT workspaces.
Demonstrate compliance with local health and safety guidelines.
Evaluate the effectiveness of health and safety protocols in digital environments.
Implement corrective actions for non-compliance with safety regulations.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the roles within a digital product team

performance_criteria.description: Identify key roles in digital product development teams.
Explain the responsibilities of each team member in the development process.
Evaluate the interdependence between different roles.
Demonstrate the ability to collaborate with various roles in a project.

learning_outcomes.description: Foster collaboration in cross-functional teams

performance_criteria.description: Identify tools and techniques for effective team collaboration.
Apply conflict resolution strategies to maintain team harmony.
Evaluate team performance and propose improvements.
Demonstrate the use of digital collaboration tools (e.g., Slack, Trello).

learning_outcomes.description: Enhance communication within product teams

performance_criteria.description: Apply effective communication techniques in digital product meetings.
Demonstrate clarity and precision in written and verbal communication.
Evaluate the impact of communication breakdowns on project timelines.
Suggest improvements to enhance team communication flow.

learning_outcomes.description: Evaluate team performance in product development cycles

performance_criteria.description: Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) for team performance.
Analyse team performance using established metrics.
Provide constructive feedback for team improvement.
Propose changes to improve overall team efficiency.

learning_outcomes.description: Develop effective communication strategies for stakeholders

performance_criteria.description: Identify key internal and external stakeholders in product development.
Demonstrate tailored communication for different stakeholder groups.
Evaluate stakeholder feedback for product adjustments.
Demonstrate the ability to mediate between conflicting stakeholder interests.

learning_outcomes.description: Communicate product vision and goals clearly

performance_criteria.description: Craft clear and concise product vision statements.
Demonstrate the ability to present product goals to a team.
Evaluate the alignment of the team’s work with the product vision.
Adjust communication to ensure alignment with changing product goals.

learning_outcomes.description: Use digital tools to enhance communication

performance_criteria.description: Identify suitable communication tools for various team sizes and types.
Demonstrate the ability to manage communication through project management tools.
Evaluate the effectiveness of communication channels (e.g., email, video meetings).
Implement changes to improve communication efficiency using digital tools.

learning_outcomes.description: Manage conflict through effective communication

performance_criteria.description: Identify common sources of conflict in digital product management.
Demonstrate active listening and empathy in conflict resolution.
Evaluate different conflict management strategies.
Propose communication solutions to resolve specific conflicts.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the digital product lifecycle

performance_criteria.description: Identify the stages of the digital product lifecycle.
Explain the activities associated with each stage of the lifecycle.
Demonstrate the ability to create a product roadmap.
Evaluate product progress through its lifecycle.

learning_outcomes.description: Identify key stakeholders in product development

performance_criteria.description: List the main stakeholders involved in digital product management.
Demonstrate how to engage stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
Evaluate stakeholder feedback for product improvement.
Propose strategies for maintaining stakeholder engagement

learning_outcomes.description: Use digital product management tools effectively

performance_criteria.description: Identify essential tools used in digital product management.
Demonstrate the ability to manage tasks using product management software.
Evaluate the efficiency of different tools in managing the product lifecycle.
Propose new tools or methods to improve product management.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply product management methodologies

performance_criteria.description: Identify common methodologies used in product management (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall).
Demonstrate the ability to apply Agile principles in product management.
Evaluate the effectiveness of various methodologies in different project environments.
Adjust methodologies to meet the needs of a specific project.

units.title: AGILE AND LEAN PRACTICES FOR PRODUCT MANAGERS

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Agile principles in product management

performance_criteria.description: Explain the core principles of Agile methodology.
Demonstrate the ability to implement Agile processes (sprints, backlogs).
Evaluate team performance in Agile environments.
Propose improvements for Agile practices in a product development cycle.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply Lean principles to reduce waste in product development

performance_criteria.description: Identify types of waste in product development.
Demonstrate the ability to streamline product development processes.
Evaluate the efficiency of Lean practices in reducing costs and time.
Propose solutions for minimizing waste in future projects.

learning_outcomes.description: Incorporate customer feedback into product iterations

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate how to gather and prioritize customer feedback.
Apply feedback to improve product features and functionality.
Evaluate the effectiveness of feedback loops in Agile practices.
Propose changes to better integrate feedback into development cycles.

learning_outcomes.description: Manage iterative product releases effectively

performance_criteria.description: Demonstrate the ability to plan and execute iterative product releases.
Evaluate the impact of incremental releases on user satisfaction.
Adjust product roadmaps based on release outcomes.
Propose strategies for managing future releases.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the key components of a digital product strategy

performance_criteria.description: Identify the main elements of a digital product strategy (vision, goals, roadmap).
Demonstrate the ability to articulate a clear product vision.
Evaluate the alignment of the strategy with business objectives.
Propose enhancements to an existing product strategy.

learning_outcomes.description: Conduct a thorough market analysis to inform product strategy

performance_criteria.description: Identify key market trends and competitors in the digital product space.
Demonstrate the ability to perform SWOT (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats) analysis.
Evaluate the potential market opportunities for a new or existing product.
Apply market analysis results to refine product positioning and strategy.

learning_outcomes.description: Create a product roadmap aligned with strategic goals

performance_criteria.description: Develop a high-level product roadmap that outlines key milestones.
Demonstrate how to prioritize features and releases based on strategic goals.
Evaluate the feasibility of the product roadmap within the given resources.
Propose adjustments to the roadmap to address changes in market or business conditions.

learning_outcomes.description: Align product strategy with organizational resources and capabilities

performance_criteria.description: Identify the internal resources needed to execute the product strategy (people, technology, budget).
Demonstrate the ability to align cross-functional teams with strategic product goals.
Evaluate the organization's capabilities to meet the product's strategic demands.
Propose solutions for resource gaps that may hinder the execution of the strategy.

units.title: DESIGN THINKING AND USER-CENTRED PRODUCT DESIGN

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the principles of Design Thinking in product development

performance_criteria.description: Explain the key stages of the Design Thinking process (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test).
Demonstrate the ability to apply Design Thinking to solve a user problem.
Evaluate the effectiveness of using Design Thinking to drive innovation.
Propose ways to integrate Design Thinking into ongoing product development.

learning_outcomes.description: Incorporate user-centred design into product development

performance_criteria.description: Identify the core principles of user-centred design (UCD).
Demonstrate the ability to create user personas and journey maps.
Evaluate the product's design based on user feedback and interaction data.
Propose design changes to improve user experience and satisfaction.

learning_outcomes.description: Use prototyping to test and refine product concepts

performance_criteria.description: Identify different types of prototypes (low-fidelity, high-fidelity) and their uses.
Demonstrate how to create and test a prototype with users.
Evaluate user feedback gathered from prototype testing.
Propose iterations on the prototype based on test results.

learning_outcomes.description: Apply user feedback to refine product design and features

performance_criteria.description: Identify methods for gathering qualitative and quantitative user feedback (surveys, interviews, usability tests).
Demonstrate how to prioritize user feedback based on product goals.
Evaluate the impact of user-driven changes on the product’s usability and value.
Propose adjustments to the product design based on continuous feedback loops.
